intro: Beneath Moonbrook, the Deadmines lie silent under a ruined town in Westfall. Once the greatest gold producer in human lands, the mines were abandoned during the First War. Now rumors speak of sinister forces in the forgotten shafts, though their danger remains unknown.

sections.t: A Vein of Gold and Blood
p: The Deadmines once led all human mines in gold, with Whitestone oak for timber and supports. When the orcish Horde pushed north, miners fled in haste. Sir Anduin Lothar entered the treacherous depths to recover the sacred Tome of Divinity. Subterranean ogres held him captive for twenty months before rescuers freed him. After the kingdom fell, the shafts went quiet, and people came to say they were cursed.
